_comment: PAGES A PERSON CHECKS BY HAND, as per-authority DATA: loaded by backend/src/handCheckPages.ts and shown on the dashboard's 'Destinations to confirm' view beside the authority. One record per public page that REFUSED an automated read (connection reset, a bot wall, an HTTP error) when the reference rows were researched, so the authority's rows may be missing what that page says. Copied from the research workers' local checklists (soft-runs/refdata-*-local-checklist.md, 2026-11-10). A record names no filing door and verifies nothing: it is a link a person opens in a normal browser, then records what they read through the dashboard's own Confirm / Edit / Verify (rule 3: as a PERSON, never by editing this file). FIELDS: authorityKind ('ahj' or 'utility'); state (two letters); authority (the AHJ or utility name; an AHJ matches by its distinctive name core, so 'Example City' and 'City of Example' are the same authority; a utility by its normalized name); pageUrl (http(s), the page to open; a record with any other URL is dropped at load); happened (what the automated read got); check (what to read and record); recordedAt (date); source (the checklist it came from). A new market adds rows here, never code.
